description: Before any domain extraction, produce: (1) a per-domain dependency graph for all 8 domains (landing, billing [+credits +commerce-admin], downloads [+content +update +variant], ai, metrics [+feedback +waitlist], admin [+admin-core +admin-user +docs-admin], remote-profile, user-auth [+auth +account]) listing every helper, type, and middleware each domain consumes from the current flat `package main`; (2) a cycle map showing which moves would create import cycles; (3) a deliberate design for any new shared package(s) (e.g. `api/shared/` or `api/platform/`) needed to break those cycles, including which symbols move where and why; (4) a recommended extraction order (most-isolated first). Inputs: `scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/main.go` (Server struct), `routes.go` (18 register*Routes calls), per-domain `*_handler.go` + `*_service.go` files. Output lives in `research/summary.md` and is the contract every downstream execute item builds against. Reproduce: `ls scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/*.go`, `sed -n '33,80p' scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/main.go`, `cat scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/routes.go`. No code changes in this item.
name: lpbs-api-domain-dep-graph-and-shared-design
title: Map LPBS API per-domain dep graph + design shared package strategy
